implementation: New default-off C23RetainedBridge binds exact site, service/source objects, restricted controller session factory and pinned material policy; source inspection does not itself authorize reservation.

Full C22 inspection/source verification precedes the final mutation transaction. The final transaction repeats retained C22 actor/owner/context/candidate checks. The store validates its controller session/enablement and immutable canonical parameters before invoking the trusted bridge closure.

Inside that closure, remaining bridge flags precede the final fresh access/source callback; then expire_all, unchanged C22 closing DB gate and fresh retained byte comparison run. The already prepared native reserve SQL executes immediately afterward, without further external callbacks.
The reserve operation preserves native capacity locks/indexes, immutable identity, exact canonical request/envelope hashes, deterministic operation/job IDs and no-fake-outbox channel guards.

RetainedExecutionIdentity is private, detached and minted only after acknowledged transaction commit. capacity_reserved_at_commit is explicitly a snapshot, including false for a historical released replay; execution/publication/release/scientific authority remains false/unverified.

Explicit bootstrap reuses the existing C23 role boundary, then grants exactly nine current model column SELECT sets and UPDATE(id) on three C22 locked heads, after revoking old direct table/column privileges on those nine targets.

limitations: The controller is an independently trusted current-admission principal with documented C22 id-update permission. The unchanged native C22 immutability/FK guards may restrict actual PK changes; this review does not claim a new general read-only trigger.

External flag/source callbacks are point-in-time admission reads, while the closing DB fence atomically protects retained owner/context/approval/bytes and reserve mutation. No cross-system continuous or distributed atomic revocation guarantee is claimed.

Native fixtures use explicit preparation-only Linux descriptors and synthetic material hashes; application approval is genuine retained C22 authorization for synthetic data, not runtime image acceptance or scientific approval.

Unchanged C22 approve checks existing fake-capable enablement even for application approval. The test writer enables that check only to invoke approve, never dispatch; fake dispatch is disabled for the distinct C23 reader, and outbox/delivery counts remain zero.

No actual held-lease start consumption, runtime execution, validated output publication, physical authenticated issuer, capacity release or fullC23 acceptance is established. Those remain separate reviewed phases.
